svg.title: The creator adds a second timeline lane
svg.desc: Add a separate public-wiki lane beneath the existing incident timeline on the creator's desk. Preserve the earlier lane intact rather than rewriting it around the new report.

**Frame:** Back in the dated creator frame, `4 SEPTEMBER`. Curt has the book's familiar incident timeline on the desk, the one the reader has been following since [page 016](016.md). He draws a second horizontal lane beneath it and labels it `PUBLIC WIKI`. The upper lane keeps its label: `ARTIFACTORY`.

**Action:** The calendar the book presented as complete acquires a lane.

**Caption:**
> THE BOOK DREW ONE LANE BECAUSE ONE LANE WAS PUBLIC.

**Provenance:** `reconstructed` — creator action; the retrospective calendar is the project's construction from two sourced records.
